selection.rule: Among beta=5, n=7 profiles with gamma_hat>500, choose gamma error closest to the pool median; ties by smaller gamma then sample_id. Reuse the same latent-sample ID for beta=2.
selection.scope: Rightward-shift transmission example, not a frequency claim or an unbiased beta=2 example.

selection.rule: Among beta=5, n=7 gamma-overestimates, choose gamma error closest to the median; ties by smaller gamma then sample ID. Reuse the same latent sample for beta=2.
selection.scope: Illustrates rightward parameter transfer; does not represent every sample or establish a universal bias direction.

selection.rule: Among successful beta=5, n=7 gamma-overestimates, choose gamma error closest to the median; ties by smaller gamma then sample ID. Reuse the same latent sample for beta=2.
selection.scope: Illustrates joint rightward solutions, not a sequential gamma-first estimator or a universal bias direction.

selection.rule: Among beta=5, n=7 successful gamma-overestimates with a successful beta=2 partner, choose gamma error closest to the median of all successful beta=5 gamma-overestimates; ties by sample ID.
selection.scope: Demonstrates a rightward likelihood peak and parameter transmission, not the direction of all MLE estimates.
